description: Use this when someone asks whether the Enoshima-Kamakura Freepass, the Enoden Noriorikun day pass or single IC-card tickets are cheapest for their Kamakura day. Compares the options per adult and for the group from Shinjuku, Tokyo Station, Shinagawa or Yokohama, with or without Enoshima, four Shinjuku routes and an optional Romancecar seat, lists child fares separately, and shows a ticket receipt card. All inputs are optional. Examples: "Is the Enoshima-Kamakura Freepass worth it from Shinjuku?" / "Which ticket is cheapest for two adults and a child visiting Kamakura and Enoshima?"

romancecar.description: Romancecar seat from Shinjuku on the way out (default false).

shinjuku_route.description: From Shinjuku with Enoshima: loop = Shinjuku → Enoshima → Hase → Kamakura, back from Kamakura; loop-ody = Shinjuku → Enoshima → Hase → Kamakura, back via Enoshima and Odakyu; eno-hase = Shinjuku → Enoshima, Hase and back to Enoshima; hop = Shinjuku → Enoshima, then 4 Enoden hops along the coast. Default loop.

start.description: Where the day starts: tokyo (Tokyo Station), shinjuku, shinagawa or yokohama. Default shinjuku (the Freepass starts on the Odakyu Line).
